title: Companies dataset
description: The equity universe tracked by the app. Lives at data/companies.json.

companies.description: Primary tracked companies. Each entry must have a unique symbol.

taiwanReferenceOnly.description: Reference-only entries (no Finnhub coverage, not surfaced as a card). Symbol uniqueness is not enforced against the main companies array.

lastUpdated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last refresh of this file.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol. Uppercase. May include exchange suffix for non-US listings.

category.description: Grouping for UI cards. Observed values: ai-hyperscalers, chokepoints, ai-software, semis, cpo-light, pcb-ccl, watchlist.

currentPrice.description: Display string including currency prefix or suffix (e.g. '$892.00', 'SEK 12.50', '€3.80'). Stored as string because format varies by listing.
